name: COMPRESSION TESTING MACHINE
desc: Semi-Automatic Digital Concrete Compression Testing Machine engineered for heavy-duty strength evaluation of concrete cubes and cylinders. Features a 1000 kN capacity robust channel-type frame equipped with a Class 1 accuracy high-precision digital indicator for reliable load tracking.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS COMPRESSION TESTING MACHINE is a semi-automatic, 1000 kN capacity hydraulic compression frame engineered for high-precision compressive strength evaluation of concrete cubes, cylinders, cement mortar, masonry blocks, and bricks. Its rigid channel-type steel frame houses a high-pressure hydraulic ram and hardened, ground compression platens that apply uniform axial load to specimens up to 150 mm. A Class 1 accuracy digital indicator with micro-stabilized load cell continuously tracks applied force, enabling real-time load-versus-time or load-versus-deformation analysis. The system is widely used by civil engineering B.Sc/M.Sc students, PhD researchers, construction material chemists, and quality control engineers to verify compliance with IS 516, ASTM C39, BS EN 12390-3, and related standards. It evaluates compressive strength, ultimate failure load, and structural integrity of cementitious materials, helping to detect under-cured concrete, poor aggregate bonding, excessive porosity, or alkali-silica reaction degradation. The hydraulic loading mechanism with smooth hand-wheel release allows controlled stress application, while the digital indicator captures peak load and fracture behavior, supporting research on high-performance concrete, fiber-reinforced cement composites, and supplementary cementitious materials like fly ash, slag, and silica fume blends.
sop: Ensure the machine is placed on a rigid, level floor and connected to a stable single-phase power supply; check hydraulic oil level and cleanliness of compression platens.
Switch ON the main power isolator and allow the digital indicator to stabilize for 5 minutes.
Prepare the concrete cube or cylinder specimen as per IS 516 / ASTM C39, ensuring surfaces are plane, parallel, and free from loose particles or moisture.
Center the specimen on the lower hardened compression platen, aligning its axis with the loading ram.
Close the hydraulic release valve fully and use the hand-wheel to slowly pump hydraulic pressure until the upper platen just contacts the specimen.
Press the 'SET' button once on the digital indicator to enter target load/peak-hold configuration mode.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter (e.g., expected maximum load or test speed limit).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value and return to live load display.
Apply load continuously and uniformly by operating the hydraulic hand-wheel at the specified stress rate (e.g., 14 N/mm²/min for cubes) while monitoring the digital indicator.
Record the peak load at first crack/failure; do not continue loading after a sharp drop in load.
Slowly open the hydraulic release valve to retract the ram, remove the failed specimen, and clean platens with a dry brush or lint-free cloth.
Switch OFF the machine and isolate power after daily use; never exceed 1000 kN capacity and always wear safety goggles, gloves, and protective footwear during testing.
